messages.subject: probe2WayMC() with fully standardized solution
parts:
Hi there,

Is it possible to get the probe2WayMC() function from SEMtools to give estimates based upon the fully standardized solution of a lavaan SEM model? (i.e., using the estimates from the "Std.all" output column rather than the "Estimate" column).

I tried first setting std.lv=TRUE, std.ov=TRUE in my original SEM model to make the Estimates column the same as Std.all, but the parameters were still not the same.

Thanks for any input you can give,
Joseph Ollier.
